parameters.name: Procore-Company-Id
parameters.description: Unique company identifier associated with the Procore User Account.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of incident severity levels configured for the company. Each severity level includes its name, notification triggers (email and push), alert recipients, and ranking order. Companies have 4-5 predefined severity levels (insignificant, minor, moderate, major, critical) that can be customized. Supports filtering by trigger flags and sorting by name.

parameters.name: filters[email_trigger]
parameters.description: Return item(s) set to trigger email notifications.

parameters.name: filters[id]
parameters.description: Return item(s) with the specified IDs.

parameters.name: filters[push_notification_trigger]
parameters.description: Return item(s) set to trigger push notifications.

parameters.name: filters[updated_at]
parameters.description:
Return item(s) last updated within the specified ISO 8601 datetime range.
Formats:
`YYYY-MM-DD`...`YYYY-MM-DD` - Date
`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`...`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ` - DateTime with UTC Offset
`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+XX:00`...`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+XX:00` - Datetime with Custom Offset

Per-Page.description: Number of items retrieved per page

Total.description: Total number of items to be retrieved

Link.description: Link headers for the first, prev, next, and last link

name.description: Name of the Incident Severity Level

procore_default_name.description: Procore default name of the Incident Severity Level

active.description: Denotes whether the Incident Severity Level is active

email_trigger.description: Denotes whether an email should be sent

push_notification_trigger.description: Denotes whether a push notification should be sent

order.description: Ranking order of the Incident Severity Level

reason.description: A human-readable code providing additional detail on the cause of the error.

import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))

patch.description: Updates the specified incident severity level's attributes. Allows modifying the display name, notification triggers (email_trigger, push_notification_trigger), and alert recipient list. The procore_default_name cannot be changed. Pass alert_recipient_ids as an array of Login Information IDs for users who should receive notifications when incidents are created with this severity level.

name.description: Display name for the severity level. Can be customized from the default (procore_default_name).

email_trigger.description: When true, email notifications are sent to alert recipients when an incident is created with this severity level.

push_notification_trigger.description: When true, push notifications are sent to alert recipients when an incident is created with this severity level.

alert_recipient_ids.description: Array of Login Information IDs for users who receive notifications (email and/or push) when an incident is created with this severity level. Replaces the existing alert recipient list.
